name: Hörnlihütte under the Matterhorn
why: Up the Matterhorn's own ridge from Schwarzsee to the climbers' hut at 3,260 m, where the north and east faces rise straight above you.
book: Lift to Schwarzsee. The hut serves meals (book a night ahead).
dangers: Steep path with metal stairs and fixed ropes.

points.name: Schwarzsee
points.note: A small lake with a chapel at 2,583 m.

points.name: Hörnlihütte
points.note: The hut at the foot of the Hörnli ridge.
